chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
Do not associate with or conduct dealings except with one who has been raised in goodness.

key_terms.تُخَالِطُوا: to mix or associate closely with others
key_terms.تُعَامِلُوا: to engage in dealings or transactions

ai.seo_question: Who should a believer associate and do business with according to this hadith?
ai.summary: The Imam عليه السلام instructs believers to be careful in both companionship and financial dealings, limiting close association to people formed by goodness. The hadith emphasizes the moral influence of upbringing on trust, conduct, and social interaction.
